NHL EDGE leaderboards

Source: R/edge.R
nhl_edge_leaders.Rd

The NHL's EDGE top 10s, all thirteen of them: fastest skaters, most distance skated, hardest shots, most offensive-zone time and shots by area for skaters; skating speed, shot speed, distance, zone time and shots by area for clubs; and 5-on-5 save percentage, save percentage by area and games above .900 for goalies. landing gives the leaders the EDGE home pages show for skaters, goalies or teams.

Usage

nhl_edge_leaders(
  metric = c("skater_speed", "skater_distance", "skater_shot_speed", "skater_zone_time",
    "skater_shot_location", "team_skating_speed", "team_shot_speed",
    "team_skating_distance", "team_zone_time", "team_shot_location", "goalie_5v5",
    "goalie_shot_location", "goalie_save_pct"),
  position = c("all", "F", "D"),
  strength = c("all", "es", "pp", "pk"),
  sort_by = NULL,
  area = c("all", "high", "mid", "long"),
  season = NULL,
  game_type = "regular"
)

nhl_edge_landing(
  type = c("skater", "goalie", "team"),
  season = NULL,
  game_type = "regular"
)

Arguments

metric

Which leaderboard: "skater_speed", "skater_distance", "skater_shot_speed", "skater_zone_time", "skater_shot_location", "team_skating_speed", "team_shot_speed", "team_skating_distance", "team_zone_time", "team_shot_location", "goalie_5v5", "goalie_shot_location" or "goalie_save_pct".

position

"all", "F" (forwards) or "D" (defence).

strength

For distance and zone time: "all", "es" (even strength), "pp" or "pk".

sort_by

The ranking (NULL picks the first): for skating speed "max", "over-22", "20-22", "18-20" (bursts in mph); for shot speed "max", "over-100", "90-99", "80-89", "70-79"; for distance "total", "per-60", "max-game", "max-period"; for zone time "offensive", "neutral", "defensive"; for shot location "sog", "goals", "shooting-pctg"; for goalies' 5 on 5 "save-pctg", "save-pctg-close", "shots", "shots-per-60"; for goalies by area "save-pctg"; for games above .900 "pctg" or "games".

area

For shot location: "all", "high" (high danger), "mid" or "long".

season

Season (see nhl_season()); NULL for the current one.

game_type

"regular" or "playoffs".

type

"skater", "goalie" or "team".

Value

A tibble, one row per player or club.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
nhl_edge_leaders("skater_speed")
nhl_edge_leaders("skater_shot_speed", position = "D")
nhl_edge_leaders("skater_shot_location", sort_by = "goals", area = "high")
nhl_edge_leaders("team_zone_time", strength = "pp")
nhl_edge_leaders("goalie_5v5", sort_by = "save-pctg-close")
nhl_edge_landing("goalie")
}
